web.description:
# How to add assets#1
## Description
I want to add clothing to makehuman-data using resources that could be provided in any number of formats.

## Activity
### wassname commented on Sep 15, 2017on Sep 15, 2017
Clothing is modular, I used a [jupyter-notebook](https://github.com/makehuman-js/makehuman-data/blob/master/scripts/notebooks/Export_proxies_to_threejs.ipynb) to convert all proxies (clothing, accessories) to threejs format.

- put your clothing/proxies into your makehuman data directory (this changes based on system) so makehuman loads it
